# Update 2026-11: owner requirements and decisions

The owner's handwritten note (`design/reference/owner-update-note-2026-11.pdf`) and the
images next to it start a new round of work: phases P18–P28. This file turns the note
into decisions the phases can rely on. When a phase file and this file disagree, this
file wins; when this file is silent, follow `04-decisions.md` and record a new ADR
(next free number: 0038).

## 2. Colour palette ("Navy trust", enhanced)

Owner palette: Ink `#1C1C1A`, Primary `#16336F`, Soft `#B1BFE2`, Ground `#F0EEDF`,
Action `#FE492A`. The enhancement keeps these five and adds the surfaces, states and
dark values an app needs. All text pairs below were measured; every one passes WCAG AA.

### Light (default)

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `canvas` | `#F6F4EC` | page background (Ground lifted a step so large areas don't look dull) |
| `sunken` | `#F0EEDF` | owner Ground: section bands, wells, input fills |
| `card` | `#FFFFFF` | cards, sheets, bars |
| `hairline` | `#E4E0CF` | borders, dividers |
| `ink` | `#1C1C1A` | primary text (15.5:1 on canvas) |
| `inkMuted` | `#56554F` | secondary text (6.8:1) |
| `inkFaint` | `#6B6A62` | hints, inactive icons (4.9:1) |
| `primary` | `#16336F` | primary buttons, links, selected states, icons (11:1 on canvas) |
| `onPrimary` | `#FFFFFF` | text on primary (12.1:1) |
| `primaryPressed` | `#0F2756` | pressed / hover |
| `primaryTint` | `#E6EBF6` | icon tiles, selected chips, info banners |
| `soft` | `#B1BFE2` | owner Soft: illustration fills, progress tracks, chips |
| `action` | `#FE492A` | owner Action: badges, live dots, highlights, illustration accents. Not for text or for white-on-orange labels (3.4:1 fails) |
| `actionStrong` | `#D4341A` | filled "urgent" buttons with white text (4.9:1) and orange text on canvas (`#C2301A`, 5.1:1) |
| `success` / `warning` / `danger` | keep current values | states |

Shadow (cards): `0 1 2 rgba(22,51,111,0.06)` + `0 8 24 -8 rgba(22,51,111,0.10)`: navy-tinted,
never grey. Large surfaces are flat colour; no gradients except the sign-in hero's 8%
fade from `canvas` into the illustration.

### Dark

| Token | Value | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `canvas` | `#0E1322` | deep navy-ink, never pure black |
| `card` | `#151B2D` | |
| `elevated` | `#1B2338` | sheets and menus |
| `hairline` | `#263049` | |
| `ink` | `#EEEBDD` | 15.5:1 |
| `inkMuted` | `#A7AEC2` | 8.4:1 |
| `inkFaint` | `#8C93A8` | 5.6:1 on card |
| `primary` | `#B1BFE2` | Soft becomes the action colour in dark mode |
| `onPrimary` | `#0E1A3A` | 9.3:1 |
| `action` | `#FF7A5E` | 7.2:1 on canvas |

`AccentPreset` gains `navy` (`#E6EBF6`, `#B1BFE2`, `#16336F`, `#0F2756`, `#0E1A3A`) and it
becomes the default instead of `midnight`. The other presets stay; every component,
including service icons, reads the active accent.

## 3. Typography

"Like Helvetica or iPhone text" means a neutral grotesque. SF Pro and Helvetica may not be
bundled in an Android or web app (licence), so:

- **iOS:** the system font (SF Pro for Latin, Kohinoor Bangla for Bangla): leave
  `fontFamily` unset on iOS.
- **Android and web:** **Inter** (OFL, drawn in the Helvetica tradition) for Latin and
  **Noto Sans Bengali** for Bangla, both bundled in `pao_ui`.
- Fraunces and Plus Jakarta Sans are removed. Headings are the same family as body at
  600–700 weight with -0.2 letter spacing; no serif anywhere.
- Keep `PaoBanglaScale` (ADR-0037) and re-check that no Bangla mark is clipped.

| Android adaptive icon | foreground `app-icons/android/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, background colour `#0B0B0C`, monochrome (Android 13 themed icons) `ic_launcher_monochrome.png`; legacy `icon-legacy-1024.png` |

Never recolour the logo with the accent, never use a font for "PAO".

## 5. Artwork (illustrations), uploadable by admins

Illustrations live in fixed **slots**. Admins replace a slot's image on a new admin page
(P23). The illustrations made in P24 are seed data: the migrator uploads them to storage
and records them like an admin upload. Each app also bundles the seed version as an offline
fallback.

| Slot key | Where | Size (px) | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer.signin.hero` | customer sign-in top area | 1170 × 1200 | 39:40 |
| `partner.signin.hero` | partner sign-in top area | 1170 × 1200 | 39:40 |
| `customer.onboarding.1`..`3` | customer welcome slides | 1170 × 1080 | 13:12 |
| `partner.onboarding.1`..`3` | partner welcome slides | 1170 × 1080 | 13:12 |
| `empty.bookings`, `empty.search`, `empty.notifications`, `empty.jobs`, `offline` | empty and offline states | 720 × 540 | 4:3 |
| `success.booking`, `success.job` | confirmation screens | 720 × 720 | 1:1 |
| `admin.login.hero` | admin web login | 1600 × 1200 | 4:3 |

Upload rules (show them on the admin page):

- **Preferred:** SVG, at most 300 KB, sanitised on upload (no scripts, no external
  references, no embedded fonts). Otherwise PNG or WebP at exactly the size above, with a
  transparent background, at most 800 KB.
- Ratio must match the slot within 2%, or the upload is refused with the expected size.
- Keep the subject inside the central 80% (safe area); the sign-in hero's bottom 15% sits
  under the rounded sheet.
- No text inside illustrations (they must work in both languages).
- Only palette colours (§2); the admin page shows the palette.

Illustration style (from the demo, `design/reference/sign-in-illustration-demo.jpg`): flat
vector, line-and-fill, monochrome navy family. Outlines in Primary, fills in Soft, Ground and
white, at most two small Action accents. No gradients, no drop shadows. Bangladeshi in what
it shows, not in colour: rickshaws and rickshaw-art motifs, tea stalls, tiffin carriers,
bazar jute bags, Dhaka rooftops with water tanks, banana and coconut trees, Shaheed Minar
and Sangsad Bhaban silhouettes, sarees, salwar kameez, lungis, kantha-stitch borders. No
real people, brands or logos other than PAO. Flags only as small palette-tone shapes.

## 6. Tagline

Setting `brand.tagline` with `en` and `bn` (max 40 characters each), edited on the admin
Settings page and audited. Owner's working line: "চাও it, PAO it". Seed default:

- **bn:** `যা চাও, তাই PAO`: "whatever you ask for, you get" (পাও = "you get").
- **en:** `Ask for it. PAO it.`

Alternatives shown to the owner on the admin page as suggestions: `চাও it, PAO it`,
`চাইলেই PAO`, `Need it? PAO it.`. Shown on splash, sign-in, the share text and the receipt
footer.

## 7. Maps: free, Dhaka only

Copying ("crawling") data out of Google Maps is against Google's terms and would put the
API key and account at risk, so it is **not** done. The same cost goal is met with
OpenStreetMap data, which is free and licensed for this (ODbL: show "© OpenStreetMap
contributors").

- **Points / address search:** import the Dhaka area (bounding box from Geofabrik's
  Bangladesh extract, clipped with osmium) into the existing PostGIS database as a `places`
  table: POIs, streets, areas and `addr:*` with en/bn names. Search with `pg_trgm`, served by
  the backend. A `migrate import-places` command refreshes it monthly.
- **Map tiles:** MapLibre with a Dhaka-only PMTiles file built from the same extract,
  served from the existing S3/RustFS bucket. Styled with the palette in light and dark.
- `google_places.dart` and the Places API key are removed. The maps port stays, so an adapter
  can be swapped later.

## 8. Notifications that pop up

Root cause found in the code: no Android notification channel with high importance exists
(FCM falls back to the default "Miscellaneous" channel, which never shows heads-up), the
FCM payload sets no `channel_id`, iOS foreground presentation is not enabled, and
foreground messages are not shown at all. P18 fixes all four for every notification type.

## 9. Motion

The owner wants smooth, simple but beautiful animation when the app opens and on every
transition, and it must not feel slow or freeze on low-end phones. Decisions:

- One set of motion tokens (P27) used everywhere; short durations (100–400 ms), ease-out enter,
  faster exit, almost no overshoot.
- The logo settles in on a cold start only, while data loads; it never adds waiting time.
- Only transform and opacity animate. Low-end devices, battery saver and the OS "reduce motion"
  setting get a lighter set (cross-fades only).
- Measured, not guessed: a profile-mode performance test with frame budgets on a low-end
  reference device is part of the gate.
